attribute_information.Batch: The specific fermentation bin, labelled based on bacteria species and replicates 1-5.
attribute_information.OD: The optical density of the bacteria inoculum used for each fermentation.
attribute_information.Temperature_at_24h: Temperature measured at the center of the fermentation bin 24 hours after the beginning of the fermentation.
attribute_information.Temperature_at_48h: Temperature measured at the center of the fermentation bin 48 hours after the beginning of the fermentation.
attribute_information.pH_at_48h: Calculated pH of a sample taken from the center of the fermentation bin 48 hours after the beginning of the fermentation.

meta.description: Fermentation can be used as an alternative feed processing technique. This experiment involves fermenting soybean meal with two different probiotic bacteria species, BS9 and L5, in order to further study the positive effects it may have on intestinal health and antimicrobial function when fed to swine.
meta.name: Soybean Meal Fermentation
